messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video produced by the first hairstyle change, then use it as the starting point for the following edit: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a tiled rooftop, raises one arm to touch her hair, places the other hand on her hip, then turns slightly toward the camera while continuing to adjust her hair.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot from behind and to the side of the character.","clothing":"She wears a dark green sleeveless top with white trim, a short black-and-gold patterned skirt, and bright blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Light brown to auburn.","hairstyle":"Short, straight hair cut above the shoulders.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a slim build and dark skin, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A stylized city rooftop at dusk, with tiled flooring, metal structures, cranes, and buildings with glowing windows and neon signs in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a road under a concrete overpass to a tiled rooftop with metal structures, cranes, buildings, glowing windows, and neon signs matching the reference. The woman remains in the same position and performs the same hair-adjusting and turning motion, with similar low-angle framing.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original road/underpass environment with the rooftop city setting from the reference, while preserving the woman's identity, clothing, pose/action, and the existing camera framing and movement.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement are exactly identical to the source, since the new scene makes precise comparison difficult
unexpected_changes: Lighting on the person changed from bright daylight to warmer dusk lighting, consistent with the new environment
